rubric.role_summary: Senior security incident response role leading complex investigations in cloud-native or SaaS environments and engineering automation and workflows to improve response.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior security incident response role leading complex investigations in cloud-native or SaaS environments and engineering automation and workflows to improve response.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of experience in security incident response roles.
- Incident response experience in cloud-native or SaaS environments.
- Experience building automation or internal tooling to improve security operations.
- Proficiency in scripting or programming and working with APIs or orchestration platforms; Python, Go, and Bash are examples, not a required set.
- Understanding of modern attacker techniques and incident response methodologies.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- 5+ years of experience in security incident response roles, with 3+ years focused on security engineering and automation.
- Experience leading complex security incidents in cloud-native or SaaS environments.
- Familiarity with applying AI/ML-assisted workflows to operational security use cases.
- Project management skills to own complex projects.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States; Canada. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
